Anna usually eats rice for lunch. The moon-lit yard is not far from my home. Anna and Amy are in the same class. For example, the road to the village is now smooth and safe.
We talk about math a lot. Amy often helps me with math. The dragon boat river is big and clean. Best of all, the children share the housework at weekends.
After school, we play together. Amy likes rice too. Anna drinks juice every morning.
